column7: behavioural half of credential-under-suspend-001/002 (#2701), the sweep-committed-first ordering: once the owner is suspended, deprovisioned, is_active=false, in an unrecognized state, soft-deleted or missing, CreatePersonalAccessToken, CreateSession and RotateSession must each refuse AND leave no credential row; every login-capable state still mints (positive controls). Red with the owner re-check made a no-op, which the race tests cannot see on SQLite.
